name: 手捧花与胸花搭配色系检测

map.输入手捧花主色与胸花搭配色，按色相搭配理论检测同类/邻近/对比关系，给出和谐度评: Enter the bouquet's main colour and the boutonniere's companion colour to check their relationship — monochromatic, analogous or contrasting — under colour-harmony theory, with a harmony score and styling advice
map.📖 查看「手捧花与胸花搭配色系检测 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Bouquet & Boutonniere Colour Harmony Checker" guide
map.按色相环夹角判定配色关系：夹角 0 至 15 度为同类色、15 至 45 度为邻: The relationship is judged by the angle between the two hues on the colour wheel: 0–15° monochromatic, 15–45° analogous, 45–120° medium-contrast, and 120–180° contrasting or complementary. For the harmony score, analogous pairs score highest (about 90), monochromatic pairs next (about 80) and complementary pairs around 70 — but they need lightness and saturation to work together. When the lightness gap exceeds 30 or the saturation gap exceeds 40, points are deducted to keep the look balanced.
map.📚 深度解析：手捧花与胸花色系搭配检测: 📚 In depth: checking bouquet and boutonniere colour harmony
map.定手捧花主色后，用它检测胸花、伴娘服或桌花的搭配色是否协调。: Once the bouquet's main colour is fixed, use the tool to check whether the boutonniere, bridesmaid dresses or table flowers sit in harmony with it.
map.之间比较和谐度评分，选最稳的一组。: by harmony score and pick the safest combination.
map.撞色风格婚礼里确认对比是否过强，需要加白色或中性色缓冲。: For a bold colour-block wedding, check whether the contrast is too strong and whether white or a neutral is needed to soften it.
map.主色 #FF6B8A（H 347°/S 100%/L 71%）：配 #FFC0C: Main colour #FF6B8A (H 347° / S 100% / L 71%): paired with #FFC0CB (H 350°) the hue difference is 3° → monochromatic, base score 92, lightness gap 17%, saturation gap 0%, final score 92, "highly harmonious"; paired with #FF8C69 (H 14°) the hue difference is 27° → analogous, 88, "fairly harmonious"; paired with #4A90D9 (H 211°) the hue difference is 136° → contrasting, base score 64, lightness gap 14%, saturation gap 35% (no deduction triggered), final score 64, "contrast on the strong side" — keep the main colour above 70% of the arrangement and use the companion colour only as an accent, with white as a buffer.
map.先按色相差判定关系并给基础分（同类 92 / 邻近 88 / 类似 84 / 中: The hue difference sets the relationship and a base score (monochromatic 92 / analogous 88 / similar 84 / medium-contrast 72 / contrasting 64 / complementary 58). Then a lightness gap above 40% deducts 10 points and a saturation gap above 50% deducts 8, with a floor of 40.
map.白色的饱和度接近 0，色相在 HSL 里不稳定，检测结果参考意义有限。白色通常作: White has a saturation near 0, so its hue is unstable in HSL and the result has limited value. White normally acts as a buffer colour — better to test with a chromatic main colour and companion colour.
map.色相差按 0°–180° 取最小夹角计算，对应同类色、邻近色、类似色、中差色、对: The hue difference uses the smallest angle within 0°–180°, mapping to six relationships: monochromatic, analogous, similar, medium-contrast, contrasting and complementary
map.婚礼花艺建议优先采用同类/邻近/类似色，过渡柔和、视觉统一: For wedding flowers, monochromatic, analogous or similar colours are preferable — softer transitions and a more unified look
map.对比色与互补色视觉冲击强，需控制面积比例（主色占 70% 以上）: Contrasting and complementary colours create strong visual impact, so control the area ratio — the main colour should cover more than 70%
map.手捧花与胸花搭配色系检测工具，基于 HSL 色彩模型计算两色色相差，判定同类、邻: A bouquet-and-boutonniere colour harmony checker. Using the HSL colour model it computes the hue difference between two colours, classifies the relationship as monochromatic, analogous, similar, medium-contrast, contrasting or complementary, and returns a harmony score with floral styling advice. Everything runs in the browser and no data is uploaded.
